_readme: Automatic sign-out for inactivity. Edit here; no code change needed.
idleTimeoutMinutes: signed out after this long with no activity (clicks, keys, touch, scrolling).
warningSeconds: a 'Stay signed in?' box appears this long before sign-out.
keepaliveEveryMinutes: while the user is active, the session is renewed at most this often. Keep it well under idleTimeoutMinutes.
